grammar.title: Should / ought to para hábitos sostenibles
grammar.explanation: Para recomendar hábitos que cuidan el planeta se usa 'should' u 'ought to'.

examples: We ought to turn off the lights when we leave.
Should we use more public transport?
We should recycle all our plastic
Sustainability is important for our future
We should use more renewable energy
You ought to reuse plastic bags
